question: Can the map page load without evaluating the usp contract schemas, so its first load has no frame over
100 ms?
method: As S9.6c: runtime ulpin-reh-23 started from its own checkout, base (94d09157) and this branch built and previewed
against it at once, Chromium from E:/ms-playwright headed with ANGLE D3D11, 1440x900, a Studio window open 5 s
before the map window, long animation frame entries with scripts mapped through each build's source maps. Map
window: the OGC LoD2 package area; frames from navigation to 500 ms after the canvas. Nine alternating runs each.
Chunk evaluation was also timed alone on an empty same-origin page (three times each).

notAtMapStart: IntakeTray.tsx: itemPendingKinds; needs-model.ts: batchStep, isIntakeReading, itemPendingKinds, itemTableSource,
needsLayoutAnswer; BatchTableSection.tsx: itemTableSource; page-image-model.ts: isPageImage, canAnswer;
question-model.ts: needsLayoutAnswer; retry-command.ts: canRetryStopped, stoppedReason; map/surface/las.ts:
imports.schemaNeededAtStart: none: every Studio import of @ulpin/contracts/usp used plain helpers only

move: from project-identity.ts, POINT_BATCH_RECORD_LENGTHS from point-batch.ts, and export * of intake-needs.ts.
intake-needs.ts now holds INTAKE_TABLE_READER_FORMATS (from intake.ts) and imports intake.ts for types only.
project-identity.ts, point-batch.ts and intake.ts re-export each moved value; the usp index, server code, schemas
and openapi are unchanged. The ten Studio modules above import @ulpin/contracts/usp/plain. normalizeProjectCode
gained two unreachable empty fallbacks and charAt so the Studio's noUncheckedIndexedAccess accepts it (same
results); the Studio type shim contracts-usp.d.ts now re-exports plain.ts instead of hand-kept declarations.
build: Base: the map page's static closure evaluates the usp barrel chunk (171 KB, 45-50 ms alone) and the chunk it
imports (zod and intake schemas, 204 KB, 47-49 ms). Branch: no usp barrel chunk is built at all; plain is a
2.4 KB chunk (0 ms). Still evaluated at map start: zod (95 KB, 9 ms) and upload-reader-limits (100 KB, 48-52 ms),
reached through upload-model.ts and batch-model.ts (@ulpin/contracts/upload-reader-limits) and run/model.ts,
evidence/api.ts, confirm-model.ts (INTAKE_TARGET_LIMITS, INTAKE_EVIDENCE_LIMITS from usp/intake.ts): the limits
constants live in schema modules. evidence/citedRegion.ts parses PacketRegionProvenanceSchema (a real schema,
only when a region is opened; packet-region now sits in the EvidenceContext chunk).

mapCodeLoads.otherScripts: query notify 53-60 ms and warm-up compile 47 ms, in their own frames under 100 ms, both builds
reading: Evaluation fell by 33-36 ms in every run. Whether it lands in the first render frame (60-66 ms, no script) is
a race: base merged 6 of 9 (167-178 ms), branch 4 of 9 (129-146 ms). Unmerged frames: base 103-105, branch
67-74 ms. Target not met: about 30 ms more must come off the evaluation, and the upload-reader-limits chain
(about 50 ms) is the rest of it.

tests: apps/studio src/types/contracts-plain.test.ts: plain.ts and intake-needs.ts, types stripped, import only each
other and run as data-URL modules where no package resolves; a P3 code round-trips. Fails when plain.ts imports zod.
notVisual: No screen, text or layout change.
